text: Final no-go: Gale will not adopt Ravel-backed dense storage for this release. Stable ravel-core exposes no ownership-safe raw Double SPI, and the compatibility matrix accepts no raw zero-copy layout/ownership class. Gale retains independent DVec/DMat DoubleArray storage and explicit logical-copy interop; dependency direction remains Gale -> Ravel, while algebra, backends, FFM, and native storage remain Gale-owned.
